data.one_liner: Flutter icon package for Tabler Icons with regular updates from upstream.
data.what_it_does: Provides Tabler Icons as Flutter widgets supporting size, stroke width, color customization, and IconTheme support.
use_when: You want to use Tabler Icons in your Flutter application.
You need icons that stay updated with the latest upstream Tabler Icons releases.
avoid_when: You prefer using standard Material Design or Cupertino icons.
You need raw icon data or font files instead of direct widgets.
strengths: Keeps up to date with the latest upstream Tabler Icons versions.
Simple API with configurable size, stroke width, and color.
weaknesses: Font and SVG icon data are no longer available as of v3.17.0 (icons must be used as widgets).
Breaking changes introduced in v4 regarding icon widget arguments.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Font Awesome icons over Tabler Icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Lucide icons instead.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want Material Symbols instead of Tabler Icons.
